title: Tensor realization and its canonical augmentation map
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category enriched over small simplicial sets [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set] with chosen simplicial tensors and cotensors [def-coef-simplicial-tensor-cotensor], and suppose $\mathcal C$ is cocomplete. Use the tensor transpose of [lem-coef-simplicial-undercategory-model], namely the inverse of the enriched tensor representing isomorphism on vertices. For $X:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C$, set $D_n=X_n\otimes\Delta^n$ and $R_\alpha=X_n\otimes\Delta^m$ for every $\alpha:[m]\to[n]$, where $\Delta^n=\operatorname{Hom}_\Delta(-,[n])$. The tensor parameter map $1_A\otimes f:A\otimes K\to A\otimes L$ is the transpose of $K\xrightarrow{f}L\xrightarrow{\eta_{L,A}}\underline{\operatorname{Map}}(A,A\otimes L)$. Define $l,r:\coprod_\alpha R_\alpha\rightrightarrows\coprod_n D_n$ by the summand maps $X(\alpha)\otimes1$ into $D_m$ and $1\otimes\Delta^\alpha$ into $D_n$, respectively, and define $|X|=\operatorname{coeq}(l,r)$. For every natural augmentation $\varepsilon:X\to\operatorname{const}Y$, define $a:\coprod_n D_n\to Y$ by transposing the constant simplicial family of $\varepsilon_n:X_n\to Y$ on each summand. Naturality gives $a\circ l=a\circ r$: on the $\alpha$ summand these are the transposes of the constant families of $\varepsilon_m\circ X(\alpha)=\varepsilon_n$. The canonical realization augmentation $|X|\to Y$ is $\operatorname{coeq.desc}(a)$ with this equality; equivalently it is the unique arrow whose composite with each summand inclusion is the indicated transpose.

source.place: A Primer on Homotopy Colimits, Section 3.1 (realization coequalizer), Section 3.7 (augmentation by collapse), and Section 19.1 (simplicial tensors), printed pp.9,11,90; read online 2026-10-17.
